name: How often should I get a roof edge assessment for my DFW property?

mainEntity.name: How often should I get a roof edge assessment for my DFW property?

acceptedAnswer.text: For properties in the DFW area, it is recommended to get a roof edge assessment at least once every 1-3 years, or after severe weather events. The frequent storms and fluctuating temperatures in North Texas can accelerate wear and tear on roof edges. Regular inspections help catch damage early, which is a key factor in extending your roof's life and avoiding emergency repairs caused by specific regional weather patterns.
acceptedAnswer.description: In DFW, roof edge assessments are recommended every 1-3 years or after severe weather due to local climate accelerating wear, helping catch damage early.
